entities.title: Usage log records
entities.summary: Tool calls write versioned records with stable sessions, response hashes and view source metrics while hiding free text; gap reports remain plain text by design.
criteria: The server lists no tools, and a find_symbol called by name writes a v2 record with the caller's session and a response hash without the name it was asked for
A view reports source size, line count and transformation counts
The report summarises daemon final-delivery records and session-dedupe savings
report_gap's note appears in the log's note field
entities.details: Rotation at 20 MiB and the readable first element and flags of array arguments are not covered by a test.

entities.title: The whole suite
entities.summary: All xunit tests of the tool, which must pass on Linux and macOS.
criteria: dotnet test tests passes; each folder's verification.json lists what its tests check

checks.description: Run in src/macos/csharp-indexer/. CI's dotnet stage runs it on Linux; the release runs it on the owner's Mac and in the Linux container.
